text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたとスコールは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Squall are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとスコールは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Squall are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
おたがいに認めあえるライバルに出会うか、
気に食わなくても、気になる同士か……。
text.official_en: To find someone whose skills you respect, even should your personalities clash, will do wonders for your motivation.
text.real_en: Perhaps you would meet a rival whose ability you respect—or someone who gets under your skin despite your differences.

text.jp:
かけがえのない人がいて、想いを胸に戦えるなら
あなたは決してひとりではないのです。
text.official_en: Even when those dear to you are not present on the battlefield, when you arm yourself with your love for them, you do not fight alone.
text.real_en: If you have someone precious to you and carry your feelings for them into battle, you are never truly alone.

text.jp:
かたくなだった心を、解かしてくれた人への
想いがスコールを支え、戦う力となりました。
text.official_en: Squall, too, was not alone, for the woman who softened his tough demeanor was always in his thoughts, giving him the strength to fight.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp: さまざまな人と出会いたい
text.official_en: By meeting new people.

text.jp:
しかし彼が想いを寄せた女性リノアは
魔女の運命に囚われてしまいます。
text.official_en: In spite of Squall’s efforts, his beloved Rinoa would suffer a most tragic—and supernatural—fate.
text.real_en: But Rinoa, the woman he loved, became trapped by a sorceress’s fate.

text.jp:
そう誓ったスコールは迷いを断ち切り
想いを貫いて、リノアを救ったのです。
text.official_en: Squall felt similarly; he vowed to be Rinoa’s knight regardless, and that stalwart devotion is what saved her.
text.real_en: Having made that vow, Squall set his doubts aside, stayed true to his feelings and saved Rinoa.

text.jp:
その中に、周囲に実力を認められながらも
人づきあいを好まない生徒がいました。
text.official_en: Of its many students, one in particular stood out. Though his martial prowess was known to all, he spurned most social contact.

text.jp: それでも誰にも頼らない
text.official_en: Refuse help, no matter the circumstances.
text.real_en: Still refuse to rely on anyone.

text.jp: それは、過去と未来の魔女を畏れる異界の記憶――
text.official_en: This was a world in which people lived in fear of sorceresses past and present.
text.real_en: These are memories of another world where sorceresses of the past and future were feared—

text.jp:
それは超常の力を受け継ぐ魔女。
世界を戦火で覆うほどの存在です。
text.official_en: That threat came in the form of a sorceress—one who inherited enough power to plunge the world into conflict.

text.jp:
それも一途な愛でしょうが、彼はあきらめず
宇宙の闇を漂うリノアを救いました。
text.official_en: That is indeed its own sort of devotion. Squall, however, chose to persevere and save Rinoa as she drifted through space.

text.jp:
たったひとりでも戦えるなら頼もしいですが
スコールは少し違いました。
text.official_en: Could you truly defeat them alone, your courage would be extolled. Squall, however, was of a different mind.
text.real_en: Being able to fight even on your own would be reassuring, but Squall took a somewhat different approach.

text.jp:
たとえ魔女でも、想いは変わらない。
どんな運命であろうと彼女を守るだけ。
text.official_en: Though they may gain new powers, your feelings toward them—and your desire to protect them—would remain the same.
text.real_en: Even if she became a sorceress, your feelings would not change. Whatever her fate, you would protect her.

text.jp:
ともに学んだサイファーとスコール。
ふたりの因縁はもつれ、何度も衝突します。
text.official_en: Squall had Seifer, and without their many confrontations, he may not have become so skilled a pugilist.
text.real_en: Squall and Seifer trained together. Their rivalry grew tangled, and they clashed time and again.

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
ひとりでは力不足だと、素直に認めて
助けを乞えば、きっと協力が得られます。
text.official_en: Be honest with yourself when you are overburdened, and genuine in your entreaty, and you are sure to receive the support of others.
text.real_en: If you admit you are not strong enough on your own and ask for help, others will surely lend you their strength.

text.jp:
めざす目標があるなら、他人にかまわず
学んで自分を高めることが大切ですね。
text.official_en: One cannot rely on others in every situation. Thus, the ability to learn on one’s own is vital to one’s success.
text.real_en: If you have a goal, it is important to study and improve yourself without worrying about others.

text.jp:
わかりあえても、ぶつかっても
出会いが人を変え、育てるものです。
text.official_en: Whether or not you have the same values, meeting someone new is an opportunity to grow as a person.
text.real_en: Whether people understand one another or clash, meeting others changes them and helps them grow.

text.jp:
スコールがパーティーで出会った彼女……
運命の出会いが、彼を変えていきます。
text.official_en: For Squall, that rang doubly true, as the mere act of sharing a dance with someone altered the course of his life.
text.real_en: The woman Squall met at a party... That fateful meeting would change him.

text.jp:
スコールの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.

text.jp:
スコールも、周囲と打ち解けるよりも
訓練に打ち込んでいました。
text.official_en: Squall often eschewed the company of others, and his training was all the more profitable for it.
text.real_en: Squall, too, devoted himself to training rather than getting close to those around him.

text.jp: 一緒に闇をさまよう
text.official_en: Drift through darkness together.

text.jp: 他人にかまう暇はない
text.official_en: Alone.
text.real_en: I have no time to worry about others.

text.jp:
他者に壁をつくりがちな彼でしたが、やがて
ひとりでは抗いようのない脅威に直面します。
text.official_en: Though Squall had a penchant for keeping his distance from others, he would eventually be faced with a threat he could not dispatch by himself.

text.jp:
他者の目を気にしていた自分を認めた上で
人とのかかわりを深めていったのです。
text.official_en: Though his aversion to social interaction was strong, he overcame his insecurities to deepen his bonds with his companions.
text.real_en: Squall acknowledged that he had been overly concerned with how others saw him, and gradually deepened his relationships.

text.jp: 仲間に語って力を借りる
text.official_en: Enlist the aid of allies.
text.real_en: Speak to your companions and ask for help.

text.jp:
傭兵を育てる学園の生徒になったら
どんな生活を送るのか――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to enroll in an academy—one with the express purpose of training mercenaries—how would you wish to spend your time there?

text.jp: 因縁のライバルと競いたい
text.official_en: By finding a rival.
text.real_en: Compete with a rival you are bound to clash with.

text.jp: 大事な人を想って戦う
text.official_en: Think of someone special for motivation.
text.real_en: Fight with someone precious in mind.

text.jp:
大切な人が、倒すべき魔女となり
救う方法が、わからなかったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were your loved one to become that which you sought to defeat—and were you at a loss for how to return them to normal—what would you do?

text.jp:
大切な人を救えないなら、運命を受け入れて
ともに闇に落ち、彼女をひとりにはしない……
text.official_en: You believe that, should you not be able to save them, the least you can do is stand by their side as they accept their dark fate.
text.real_en: If you could not save someone precious, you would accept her fate, fall into darkness with her and never leave her alone...

text.jp:
彼の名は、スコール……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That student’s name is Squall, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.

text.jp:
彼女は意に反して、世界の敵である
魔女にされてしまったのです。
text.official_en: She was unwittingly bestowed with the powers of a sorceress, becoming an enemy to the world.
text.real_en: Against her will, she was turned into a sorceress, an enemy of the world.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. Now, suppose you...

text.jp:
忘れていた過去の絆が、未来への希望に。
幼い日をともにした仲間たちがいました。
text.official_en: You—like Squall—would turn a forgotten past into hope for the future. In his case, he shared a past with his companions.
text.real_en: Bonds from a forgotten past became hope for the future. These companions had shared their childhood.

text.jp:
戦いのさなか、彼は率直な想いを明かす
演説で、ガーデンをひとつにまとめます。
text.official_en: After Squall gave a rousing speech that spoke from the heart, there was nary a soul in Balamb Garden who was not united behind him.
text.real_en: In the midst of battle, Squall brought the Garden together with a speech in which he spoke honestly from the heart.

text.jp:
時間と記憶が交錯する異界の幻影　スコール
獅子の心で魔女を支え、魔女を討つ。
text.official_en:
Time and Memory Traverser Squall
The student with the heart of a lion, both foe and champion of sorceresses.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision from a world where time and memory intertwine: Squall. With the heart of a lion, he supports one sorceress and fights another.

text.jp:
自分ひとりでは勝てない魔女に
どうやって立ち向かうか――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to oppose someone who possessed overwhelming strength—someone who you could not defeat alone—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you faced a sorceress you could never defeat alone... how would you confront her?

text.jp: 記憶をたよりに想いをつなぐ
text.official_en: Connect with them through shared memories.

text.jp:
過去と未来が意味を失う、時間圧縮という
終極を越えて、彼らはリノアを救いました。
text.official_en: Together, they overcame the threat of time compression—amidst which “past” and “future” held no meaning—and saved Rinoa.

text.jp: 魔女でもいいと覚悟する
text.official_en: Not care what they have become.
text.real_en: Resolve to accept her, even as a sorceress.

text.jp:
ＳｅｅＤと呼ばれる傭兵をめざす若者が集い、
訓練にはげむ、バラムガーデン。
text.official_en: Its tale began in Balamb Garden, a training ground for young individuals who aspired to become SeeD mercenaries.
